sources.source: Commercial vehicle testing data for Great Britain
sources.verified_fact: Official dataset covers annual, voluntary and specialist testing for heavy goods and passenger service vehicles, including sites and item-level measures.
sources.quality_effect: Vehicles, items, axles, tests and sites remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: CAA provides aggregated reported birdstrike data through 2025 and warns that report volume at an airport does not imply greater hazard.
sources.quality_effect: Reports, events, airports, species, exposure and reporting behaviour remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: CAA provides laser-incident data for 2014 to 2025 and notes that reports include UK events and UK operations overseas.
sources.quality_effect: Reports, incidents, UK locations, overseas operations and exposure remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: CAA lists 62,215 Mandatory Occurrence Reports received in 2025 and explains that reports cover varied potential safety risks.
sources.quality_effect: Reports, unique events, accidents, exposure and reporting propensity remain distinct.

sources.source: Building Safety Regulator building control approval application data
sources.verified_fact: Official collection publishes applications, determination times, decisions and statutory-time-limit performance, including April to June 2026.
sources.quality_effect: Applications, buildings, residential units, decisions, completion and rolling windows remain distinct.

sources.verified_fact: Published 29 April 2026; reports 2.617 million first registrations in 2025 and 42.3 million licensed vehicles at year end, with separate zero-emission measures.
sources.quality_effect: First registrations, licensed stock, vehicles, owners and technology categories remain distinct.

sources.source: High Speed Rail expenditure report, 2024 to 2025
sources.authority: Department for Transport and High Speed Two Limited
sources.verified_fact: Published 25 June 2026; statutory report presents expenditure under the 2013 Act from April 2024 to March 2025 by cost category.
sources.quality_effect: Spending, categories, contracts, physical progress, completion and safety remain distinct.

sources.source: Marine and Aviation Insurance War Risks Fund account: annual report 2024 to 2025
sources.verified_fact: Published 25 September 2025; presents the Marine and Aviation Insurance War Risks Fund account for 2024 to 2025.
sources.quality_effect: Accounts, policies, exposures, claims, reserves, losses and incidents remain distinct.

operations.evidence: official DVSA commercial vehicle dataset checked
items, axles, vehicles, tests and sites kept as distinct units
reported volume not interpreted as airport hazard ranking
UK events and UK operations overseas kept distinct
official CAA page lists 62,215 reports for 2025
reports not treated as accidents, unique events or exposure-adjusted risk
official collection updated with April-June 2026 data
applications, buildings, units, decisions and completion outcomes kept distinct
registrations and licensed stock kept distinct from road use or safety exposure
expenditure not interpreted as physical progress, completion or site safety
fund accounts and exposures not treated as realised incidents or losses
